evidence.text: An application's key contract should change in the same pull request as the code that needs a new key, so it should live in the repository.
opv also supports keeping the configuration as a manifest in 1Password, readable by tools and people without the repository.
Two writable copies of the configuration can drift apart.

desiredImprovement: The contract is reviewed and versioned with the code
worseningOutcome: Availability of the configuration to tools and people outside the repository
